parent_objective: run no-PPO old-key neighborhood alpha sweep before more PPO

public_gates: export exact compact reference cases from M341 compact corpus
run critical_key_replay_guard or equivalent replay for selected M335 alpha checkpoints
run old_key_neighborhood_replay_gate for each candidate versus m335_a0_0075
report largest passing alpha and first failing alpha
do not run PPO or promote a checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use static selected/endpoint columns as future candidate proof
do not lower old-key neighborhood thresholds
do not skip replay reproduction of m335_a0_0075
do not promote from alpha sweep alone
hypothesis: The replayable old-key neighborhood gate may allow a larger interpolation alpha than the old singleton 9944 floor while still rejecting the repaired endpoint direction.
success_criteria: m335_a0_0075 replay reproduces old-key neighborhood pass
candidate alphas are evaluated with replayable old-key metrics
largest passing alpha and first failing alpha are reported
failure types are classified before any PPO
failure_criteria: alpha sweep cannot reproduce m335_a0_0075 pass
guard replay rows do not cover the 40 compact cases
thresholds are changed after seeing results

commands.name: m347_run
commands.command: Run the no-PPO old-key neighborhood alpha sweep designed in docs/m346-old-key-neighborhood-alpha-sweep-design.md.

decision_rule: M347 may only run the no-PPO old-key alpha sweep and admit a follow-up exact/source-diverse probe or repair design. It cannot promote a checkpoint or run PPO.
